description: Battery drain while parked and unplugged (gaps = driving or charging).

targets.rawSql: WITH p AS (SELECT ts, battery_level, LAG(battery_level) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS prev_batt, LAG(ts) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS prev_ts FROM (SELECT v.id AS vehicle_id, t.at AS ts, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'batteryLevel') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS battery_level, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'batteryLimit') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS battery_limit, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'distanceToEmpty') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS range_km, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'vehicleMileage') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS mileage_m, (SELECT c.value FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'powerState') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS power_state, (SELECT c.value FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'chargerStatus') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS charger_status, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'cabinClimateInteriorTemperature') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS cabin_temp FROM vehicles v CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT h.at FROM state_heartbeats h WHERE h.vehicle_seq = v.seq UNION SELECT c.at FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.field_id IN (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name IN ('batteryLevel', 'batteryLimit', 'distanceToEmpty', 'vehicleMileage', 'powerState', 'chargerStatus', 'cabinClimateInteriorTemperature'))) t WHERE v.id = ${vehicle:sqlstring}) AS vehicle_state_snapshots WHERE vehicle_id=${vehicle:sqlstring} AND power_state='standby' AND charger_status='chrgr_sts_not_connected' AND $__timeFilter(ts)) SELECT SUM(GREATEST(prev_batt-battery_level,0)) / NULLIF(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ts-prev_ts)))/86400.0,0) AS value FROM p WHERE prev_ts IS NOT NULL AND ts-prev_ts < interval '1 hour' HAVING SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ts-prev_ts))) >= 21600

panels.description: Battery lost per day, from samples where the car is awake but idle (power state standby) and unplugged. Shown only with at least 6 hours of such samples in the range. A sleeping car is not counted: it reports its battery level rarely.
